props.name: container
props.description: Portal target for the popover. Defaults to the nearest `ThemeScope`, so the overlay inherits the theme it was opened from; an explicit element or ref wins.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The default value (uncontrolled). Widened to allow an explicit `null` so a form can reset the picker to empty without dropping the prop.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting copy, rendered as the private RAC `Description`.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error copy, rendered as `FieldError` when the picker is invalid. Accepts a node or a validation render function.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label, rendered as the private RAC `Label`.

props.name: presetGroup
props.description: Quick-choice pane rendered beside the calendar — normally a `DatePickerPresetGroup`. A renderable node is what turns the dialog into two panes; a falsy one (`false` from a `&&` guard, `null`, `""`) keeps the single pane.

props.name: shouldForceLeadingZeros
props.description: Pads day and month segments with a leading zero. The reference flips RAC's locale-dependent default; this port keeps that flip.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the preset pane. Defaults to the `datePicker.presets` row of the locale dictionary; an explicit string wins.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting copy carried alongside the preset, kept from the reference face. RAC `Radio` renders only its children, so this never joins the accessible name.

props.name: isCloseDialogOnDoubleClick
props.description: Closes the picker dialog on double-click, after the caller's own `onDoubleClick`. A pointer-only affordance: single click (and Space from the keyboard) selects without closing, so nothing is reachable by pointer alone.
